title: Mode-I C6 Package 171-R10 Isolated Displacement Under-Relaxation Driver Implementation and Technical Qualification

job_references.scientific_scope: Offline driver implementation and controlled unit regression testing for Candidate R10 isolated mechanical displacement under-relaxation (omega_u = 0.85 in Stage 2). Strict preservation of qualified R9 phase relaxation (omega_d=0.50 Stage 1, omega_d=0.85 Stage 2, unrelaxed step norm rollback safeguards), bitwise frozen UEL, and physical acceptance thresholds. Rejection of physical history relaxation (H_trial = max(H0, psi+(u_trial)) strictly preserved). Deferral of Stage 3 phase acceleration (omega_d = 0.95 deferred). Tracking raw-versus-relaxed mechanical displacement and independent re-equilibration gate before physical acceptance. Strictly 0 PBS submissions authorized under F1614.
